newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico mining truck plunges into ravine, kills 18.
newsitem.headline: Mexico mining truck plunges into ravine, kills 18.

text.p: Eighteen people were killed when a truck filled with miners plunged into a ravine in Mexico's southwestern Guerrero state on Monday, officials said.

Guerrero state government spokesman Roberto Alvarez Heredia told Reuters the accident happened on a gravel road not far from the silver mining town of Taxco and may have been caused by a mechanical fault.
Television showed pictures of twisted bodies and the mangled remains of the tip-truck that was carrying more than 30 people at the time.
"Never have we seen anything so terribly sad as what happened this afternoon," Alvarez said, adding the truck belonged to the Nukay gold mine.
It was not immediately clear who owned the mine.
Seventeen people died at the scene and one man later died in hospital, Alvarez said, adding he did not know how many were being treated for injuries.
